title: 3D coral-like Ni–Mo–S/NF bifunctional electrocatalyst for concurrent glycerol valorization to formate and energy-efficient H2 evolution
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,48487-48497
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08754F, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yong Liu, Bohon Chen, Hanbin Nie, Shuanglin Gui, Jianping Deng
This study developed a 3D coral-like bifunctional nanocatalyst (Ni–Mo–S/NF), enabling a faradaic efficiency of 95.0% for formate production and 99.6% for hydrogen evolution.
